privacy.title: What we do with your address
privacy.notice: Your address is used to send you a code and to manage your account. When you sign up, with your consent, it is recorded in Brevo (emails) and may be recorded in Apollo.io (commercial prospecting). It is kept while your account is open. You can access it, correct it, delete it or withdraw your consent at any time.

notReceived.title: Not receiving the code?
